author: Cleo Abram
description:
Have you seen these incredible NEW images of our Sun!?

What’s truly crazy is their scale…this giant telescope in Hawaii captured the sharpest images EVER of these plasma whirlpools and made simulations to see how they MOVE. 

To see what’s deeper inside the Sun, subscribe!

#sun #telescope #image #space #hawaii

DOI: 10.1038/s41586-026-10871-3
title: New Extreme Images of the Sun’s Surface
